features: CP PLUS 2.4MP Full HD Resolution – Captures high-quality 1080p video footage, delivering sharp images for accurate surveillance and better detail recognition.
Infrared Night Vision Up to 30 Meters – Ensures uninterrupted surveillance during complete darkness, automatically switching to black & white IR mode at night.
3.6mm Fixed Lens for Broad Coverage – Provides a balanced field of view for monitoring medium to wide indoor areas such as entrances, offices, or hallways.
Suitable for Home, Shop, or Office – Ideal for places that require discreet monitoring with wide-angle clarity and audio functionality.
description: The CP PLUS CP-URC-DC24PL3 is a 2.4MP Full HD IP Dome Camera designed for indoor surveillance needs. It offers 1080p high-definition recording, a 3.6mm fixed lens for wide coverage, and infrared night vision up to 30 meters. Its compact dome design fits well in homes, offices, and commercial setups. It supports PoE or standard power input, ensuring flexible installation.
